story: Sophie is in the garden. Sophie is looking at the big red flowers. [emotion:QT/surprised] A tiny fairy is sitting on a flower! The fairy has bright yellow wings. Sophie and the fairy are picking flowers together. Sophie puts the flowers in a round basket. The basket is on the grass. A little dog runs into the garden. The dog jumps on the basket! [emotion:QT/sad] The flowers are on the grass now. The fairy and Sophie put the flowers back in the basket together.
